items.summary: Garware Hi-Tech Films Ltd and Lubrizol have signed a memorandum of understanding for TPU technology development. An expected investment of Rs 118 crore will support new product development and technology capabilities in the TPU platform. The initiative will also enhance backward integration for GHFL's premium Paint Protection Film business.

items.title: SBI expects surplus from new UPI MDR as issuing, acquiring bank

The bank anticipates generating surplus revenue due to its extensive card issuing and payment gateway services. Initially, MDR fees will be divided among issuing and acquiring banks, payment gateways, and UPI applications. SBI is evaluating the potential impact of transaction splitting on its systems and volumes.

items.title: FSSAI proposes single-phase food warning labels, gives industry one-year transition time
items.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India intends to implement new front-of-pack nutrition labeling regulations. Food Business Operators will have one year to comply with the new labeling requirements. A red hexagonal warning label will highlight high levels of sugar, fat, and salt in packaged products. The FSSAI will adopt thresholds based on recommendations from ICMR-NIN for nutrient content.

items.title: Budget 2027-28 process begins October 12 with month-long pre-budget meetings
items.summary: Pre-budget meetings for the Union Budget 2027-28 will commence on October 12 and continue until November 13. These discussions aim to finalize the Revised Estimate for 2026-27 and the Budget Estimate for 2027-28. Ministries are required to submit necessary details by October 6 to facilitate these meetings. The Budget is expected to address economic growth, job creation, and domestic demand.

items.title: CBDT eases TDS compliance for property buyers dealing with non-residents
items.summary: The Central Board of Direct Taxes is set to simplify TDS compliance requirements for residents buying property from non-residents. From October 1, 2026, residents can use their PAN instead of obtaining a TAN for taxing purposes. This change is aimed at making tax compliance easier in such real estate transactions. Eligible resident individuals and Hindu undivided families can use Form 141 to report TDS deductions.

items.title: Financial sector must fund next generation of enterprises, not just next year's growth: P K Mishra
items.summary: The Principal Secretary to the Prime Minister P K Mishra said on Wednesday that the financial sector should move beyond financing near-term growth and focus on funding the next generation of Indian enterprises. He called for a shift in the way credit is assessed, from collateral to cash flows. Mishra said India's financial system will need to mobilise large amounts of capital for infrastructure, manufacturing, urbanisation, energy transition and innovation, with different forms of capital required for different needs.

items.title: BRICS should work together on transfer pricing as disputes burden developing nations: FM
items.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman emphasized the need for BRICS nations to improve collaboration on international taxation. She proposed establishing working groups to address transfer pricing disputes, which affect developing countries disproportionately. This effort aims to shape future cross-border taxation rules through multilateral negotiations. Revenue Secretary Arvind Shrivastava highlighted the importance of collective experience in these deliberations.

items.summary: Axis Bank appointed Arvind Subramanian as an additional independent director for a four-year term, pending shareholder approval. He holds a B.Tech in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from IIT Madras and completed his postgraduate management studies at IIM Ahmedabad.

The Reserve Bank of India may need to maintain tighter monetary policy due to external shocks.
